# Security Checklist: Árvores de fórmula ao vivo e painéis por sistema

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the security and privacy requirements of spec 008: personal data from the game state, what leaves the isolated calculation, files saved on the player's machine, the instrumented copy, no network, nothing of the game in the repository.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all kinds of personal data that can reach a tree enumerated with a rule each: character names, account identifiers and free-text values of the game state? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is the requirement that nothing of the game or the save enters the repository extended to the player's snapshot in logs, reports and `registro.md`, not only to committed files? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-032, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK003 Is the behavior defined when a calculation result would carry a piece of a character name (refuse the tree, show `unavailable`, or strip it)? [Completeness, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Is the content of every file the feature saves on the player's machine specified (what it holds, what it never holds)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for a saved file that is unreadable, corrupted or from an older version of the app (marks, tree shapes)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-025, §FR-029]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "only data leaves the calculation" defined with an explicit list of what may and may not leave? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is the "only in memory" rule for the instrumented copy stated as a testable requirement? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Is the structured log of a parity failure defined with what it carries and what it never carries (values of the math, names)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK009 Is what "Copy" in Game details puts on the clipboard limited to named fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Is the "Character N (class)" rule consistent across the tree, the panels, the Pin, the marks file, the shapes file, the logs and Copy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-019, §FR-025, §FR-026, §FR-029, §FR-030]
- [x] CHK011 Is the exception that lets the marks hold values on disk consistent with the out-of-scope "no history of values on disk"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Out of Scope]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are the new readings of live map actors restricted to read-only property reads, with no call into the running game? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK013 Is the "no network for the game" rule stated for the whole feature, including the tree worker, the live actor reading and the patch radar? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK014 Are the inactive characters covered by the same privacy rule as the active one? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK015 Is the data that crosses from the calculation to the window required to be checked (shape, size, only allowed values) before it is shown? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK016 Is the farm tracker's data scope (which character, in memory, no disk) defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK017 Is a new third-party dependency (the parser of the game's code) tied to the constitution's dependency check and the user's approval? [Dependency, Spec §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK018 Is the assumption that the attachments (design, tree catalog) carry no game text, no game table and no character name stated and checkable? [Assumption, Spec §Input]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
